question: M, N, O, P, Q, R and S are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). Q sits second to the right of M. P sits third to the left of M. N is an immediate neighbour of S and P. R is not an immediate neighbour of P. Who sits third to the left of R?
solution:
**Given: **M, N, O, P, Q, R and S are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order).

Q sits second to the right of M. P sits third to the left of M.

N is an immediate neighbour of S and P. R is not an immediate neighbour of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08f3cfa0007ec6f14802f308349f566312d95ecbe6f2d96aa59746d9e9dfda83.png] 

Thus, N is sits third to the left of R.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
